title: Turnstile skill frontmatter
description: Machine-readable form of SPEC.md's metadata table. Validated in CI by scripts/validate_skill.py on every PR. The validator normalizes comma-separated string fields (persona, connectors, scopes) into arrays before validating against this schema. Extra metadata keys are allowed (e.g. inputs/outputs may live here or in the SKILL.md body while that open item is unsettled). See CONTRIBUTING.md for how schema changes are proposed.

name.description: Must equal the skill folder name.

description.description: One-line what-it-does + when to use it, with trigger phrases. No XML/angle-bracket tags (breaks the claude.ai uploader).

version.description: Semver per SPEC.md. Official skills arrive in this repo at 1.0.0; a skill that has not cleared the release gate starts at 0.1.0.

persona.description: One or more roles, comma-separated in the YAML. 'all' is for skills that genuinely serve every role.

risk.description: Canonical wire values for the standard's Low/Med/High.

connectors.description: Connector names beyond the Turnstile MCP, comma-separated in the YAML, or the single value 'none'. Qualifiers (optional/required, read scope) belong in the SKILL.md body, not here.

scopes.description: Least-privilege Turnstile MCP scopes requested (e.g. invoices:read), comma-separated, or the single value 'none'.

audience.description: Required. Who the skill is for, and it must match where the skill lives: every skill in this repo declares 'public'. 'internal' and 'public-preview' are the values used before a skill is published (SPEC.md). The validator enforces the audience<->location pairing; the scaffold and tooling lanes are exempt.

ported-to.description: Optional. URL of the public skill folder a port produced. Valid only with audience: internal — the validator enforces the pairing — so it never appears on a skill in this repo; it marks the internal original a public skill was ported from.

surfaces.description: Optional. The runtime surfaces the skill supports, comma-separated in the YAML — the machine-readable form of SPEC.md's required 'Runs on' declaration. ABSENT MEANS ALL SURFACES, which is why it is not in `required`: every skill that predates this key supports every surface. A skill that omits `claude-ai` is not packaged into a .skill by release.yml, because that download could not work.
